name: pilfer_nonland_only
notes: Pddc71b7357 G4. Printed: 'Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.' Seat 1 holds a Forest, an Elf creature card and a Trick instant card. Seat 0 casts Pilfer ({1}{B}) at seat 1 and chooses the Elf: seat 1 discards exactly the Elf; the Forest and the Trick stay in its hand. Seat 0's own hand is untouched.
